meta.name: VÃO
meta.brief: Um círculo e quatro linhas em três telas lado a lado; o silêncio entre as telas faz parte da peça.

contract.concept: Um círculo e quatro linhas em três telas lado a lado; o silêncio entre as telas faz parte da peça.
contract.audienceEffect: The audience should feel Um círculo e quatro linhas em três telas lado a lado; o silêncio entre as telas faz parte da peça.
contract.visualLanguage: Concept silence: verbs freeze, breathe, drift, hesitate; motifs still frame, inhale and exhale, slow current, held breath; one dominant figure per composition over a quiet ground.
contract.formLanguage: Forms follow the hero generator of each composition; the structure layer keeps one module and one grid.
contract.materialLanguage: Light on a dark ground: ice, photograph; skin, membrane.
contract.colorLogic: mono scheme, OKLCH hue 230 (one cool hue, large quiet fields); one accent used for events only.
contract.spatialLogic: Canvas 5760x1080 (multi); the hero sits on the focal zone, structure on the grid, information at the edge.
contract.motionLanguage: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.824, 1% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 8 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py).
contract.typographyLanguage: Uppercase, one family; text only when the brief supplies exact words.
contract.temporalArc: one state that keeps moving, with a single shift; stillness after movement; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows establish, drift, drift.
contract.loopGrammar: cyclic: the loop closes on whole bars and every layer moves in whole cycles
contract.technicalStrategy: Generated without AI by brief_to_project.py from the structured brief; native pixels, deterministic seed, engine generators only.
contract.forbiddenShortcuts: Do not stretch 16:9 across another aspect; no unseeded randomness; no effect without a reason in the contract.
contract.focalEvent: One dominant figure per composition; everything else supports or releases it.
contract.releaseZone: The ground field and the empty third of the frame; no layer fills it.
contract.banned: shockwave rings on every hit; particle bursts; neon glow everywhere
contract.audioStrategyReason: The piece is deliberately silent: the picture must not depend on the music.

artBible.thesis: Um círculo e quatro linhas em três telas lado a lado; o silêncio entre as telas faz parte da peça.
artBible.material: Light on a dark ground (minimal); ice, photograph; skin, membrane; no fake materials, no gradients that pretend to be objects.
artBible.space: Read from far away: heavy strokes, large forms, the hero on the focal third, information at the edge.
artBible.motion: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.824, 1% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 8 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py).
artBible.dramaturgy: one state that keeps moving, with a single shift; stillness after movement; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows establish, drift, drift. Tension: relaxed; one dominant figure per composition; the ground field is the release.
artBible.color: mono scheme, OKLCH hue 230 (one cool hue, large quiet fields); one accent used for events only.
artBible.typography: No text unless the brief supplies exact words; if added: uppercase, one family, three sizes at most.
artBible.audio: Strategy none: the picture ignores the music.
artBible.banned: shockwave rings on every hit; particle bursts; neon glow everywhere

creativeIR.compositionStrategy: everything stops on one frame of the loop; the hero inhales on the downbeat
creativeIR.animationStrategy: decelerate to rest (moving to still); sine, slow in and out (in, out)

compositions.name: MINIMAL I
compositions.hypothesis: ESTABLISH: Um círculo e quatro linhas em três telas lado a lado; o silêncio entre as telas faz parte da peça.

layers.name: FUNDO
layers.role: ground colour of the piece; the quiet reference everything else is read against

layers.name: CAMPO MINIMAL I
layers.role: ground field: slow matter that gives the figure something to cut against

layers.name: ATMOSFERA I
layers.role: atmosphere: a second, fainter field in the accent that adds depth without competing with the hero

layers.name: HERÓI MINIMAL I
layers.role: hero: the single dominant figure of this composition (the focal event)

layers.name: ESTRUTURA I
layers.role: structure: the grid or rhythm the eye measures the hero against

layers.name: INSTRUMENTO I
layers.role: instrument: shows the real signal that drives the picture (cause and effect)

layers.name: MARCA I
layers.role: event: one clean mark that appears on the hit and gives the loop a landmark

layers.name: ACABAMENTO
layers.role: finish: vignette and a touch of tension; scanlines only where the surface is a screen
